lane.release.title: Release lane
lane.release.summary: Release a lane closed by hand without a lease. Refuse open issues, live leases, merge receipts, pending closes and dirty or ignored work. Remove the worktree and registry entry; keep and report the branch.

lane.close.title: Close lane
lane.close.summary: Claim the issue first. Close a merged lane with a PASS receipt, or a CLOSED unmerged PR with a dropped reason. Refuse active run locks and dirty work; resume matching close journals. keepOpen preserves the issue; discardIgnored authorizes other ignored files.

lane.start.title: Start lane
lane.start.summary: Start a capped worktree for an open issue. Brief must be in the project with Goal, Acceptance test, Files, Forbidden actions, Stop point and Prior art sections. Repeating the same arguments adopts a preserved worktree.

lane.next.title: Next lane action
lane.next.summary: Return the next action for one lane (id) or all. Pauses when autopilot is off, stopped or over budget; the merge action only when every condition holds. After a merge: receipt, close, issues, rebuild, unwatch, done.
lane.next.description: A pause becomes an owner ask. The owner channel gets one numbered ask-owner message at most every 30 minutes (a kill-switch trip goes at once) and each message has a number the reply must carry; any other session gets hand-to-owner. Until the owner channel is set with lane record ownerChannel, asks stay queued and the lane returns a plain pause.

lane.record.title: Record lane action
lane.record.summary: Record a fact Forge cannot read itself: an action result, a merge-gate verdict, the owner's verbatim reply, the request id of a gated step, or the owner channel.
lane.record.description: Give id, action and result for the open action number (a receipt id, a rebuild exit code, an unwatch confirmation or an owner decision {done:true}). Or mergeGate {head, verdict MERGE or FIX, reviewer} for one head. Or reply and source {harness, thread, message} for the owner's reply, verbatim: it must name the message number (#<n> in the reply or source.message), labels like 1A 2B map to that message's asks, ok takes every default, anything else keeps every lane paused. Or id, request and scope ({id} or {all:true}, the lane resume input) to attach a pending approval request to its ask: Forge checks the request is pending and bound to that exact step, and it is never replaced once recorded. Or ownerChannel {harness, thread}: never implicit, and like lane resume it needs the owner's reply relayed as an approval.

lane.stop.title: Stop lanes
lane.stop.summary: Set the stop flag for one lane or all lanes. After it, lane next returns only pause. Stopping needs no approval.

lane.resume.title: Resume lanes
lane.resume.summary: Clear the stop flag for one lane or all lanes. It restarts spending, so it needs the owner's reply relayed as an approval: call once without approval to get a request, ask the owner, then call again with approval {request, quote, source}.

lane.status.title: Lane status
lane.status.summary: Show every lane's step, PR, stop flag and use of its call, active time and round budgets, the stop flag and autopilot switch, and a measured load sample. hold names why a new lane would not start now: lane cap, low free memory or high CPU.

lane.show.title: Show lane
lane.show.summary: Read the recorded lane and issue lease without changing either.

issue.show.title: Show
issue.show.summary: Issue, lease; invited: mode and live participants.

issue.list.title: List
issue.list.summary: AND filters; ready=open+deps closed+unheld. createdSince: inclusive full RFC 3339 timestamp, before limit; truncated: more matches.
issue.list.description: AND filters: ready=open+deps closed+no live lease; labels/label=all-of; parent=id/none; kind. createdSince: inclusive full RFC 3339 timestamp, before limit; truncated: more matches.

issue.update.title: Update
issue.update.summary: Held lease+revision; no cycles or open epic demotion with open children.

examples.command: POSIX: forge issue update demo-1 --title "Updated task" --expect-revision "$(forge issue show demo-1 | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge issue update demo-1 --title "Updated task" --expect-revision ((forge issue show demo-1 | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

issue.update.description: Held lease + show revision. kind=task/bug/feature/epic; open epic+open children: no demotion. parent=existing id/null(clear); no cycles.

issue.claim.title: Claim
issue.claim.description: Claim an issue lease. Blocked claims need reason (CLAIM_BLOCKED/CLAIMED_BLOCKED). reopen gives why to reopen a closed issue, keeping prior close evidence; 1 to 65536 characters after trimming.

issue.renew.title: Renew
issue.renew.summary: Renew live generation/reacquire expired; ttlSeconds overrides claimTtlSeconds (3600s default).

issue.close.title: Close
issue.close.summary: Held lease; verified PASS receipt bound to delivered PR, or written withoutReceipt reason.

issue.ready.title: Ready
issue.ready.summary: Open; deps closed; no live lease; labels all-of. labelOrder: first carried label, then stored order.
issue.ready.description: Open; deps closed; no live lease (expired/released OK); all labels match. /blocks/work/config/labelOrder: first carried label, then stored order.

issue.call.title: Call
issue.call.summary: Count root-intent call; refuse after 60 calls/30h; bounded timebox.

issue.dep.title: Dep
issue.dep.summary: Held lease + expected revision; add/remove dep.

examples.command: POSIX: forge issue dep --id demo-1 --target demo-2 --action add --expect-revision "$(forge issue show demo-1 | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge issue dep --id demo-1 --target demo-2 --action add --expect-revision ((forge issue show demo-1 | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

issue.tree.title: Tree
issue.tree.summary: Open epics/root: child counts, open descendants (depth 3), parent anomalies; limit/truncated.
issue.tree.description: Open epics/root id: open/closed child counts, open descendants to depth 3, parent anomalies. limit: nodes/ids; truncated includes deeper children.

issue.lint.title: Lint
issue.lint.summary: Kinds, refs, dep cycles; open issues' closed parents (always). labels.required: exactly one match/group; empty default.

issue.join.title: Join
issue.join.summary: Invited membership; live rejoin keeps expiry.
issue.join.description: ISSUE_NOT_COLLABORATIVE: invite required. PARTICIPANT_NOT_INVITED: this holder was not invited. INPUT_CONFLICT: closed issue or coordinator joining itself. ttlSeconds overrides claimTtlSeconds (3600s fallback). Refusals write nothing.

issue.leave.title: Leave
issue.leave.summary: Release own membership; no coordinator lease.

attempt.slots.title: slots
attempt.slots.description: INPUT_INVALID: count must be 1-16. INPUT_CONFLICT: fewer slots than live attempts. Coordinator lease fence required; same count writes nothing.

attempt.reserve.title: attempt
attempt.reserve.summary: Reserve an open attempt; live retries keep their lease.
attempt.reserve.description: ISSUE_NOT_COMPETING: slots not set. ATTEMPT_SLOTS_FULL: names the limit and live ids. INPUT_CONFLICT: closed issue. Atomic reservation; one live attempt per holder. Released and expired ids remain in issue.show.

attempt.release.title: attempt-release
attempt.release.summary: Release your attempt; retain its history.

attempt.note.title: attempt-note
attempt.note.description: LEASE_EXPIRED or LEASE_NOT_HELD: expired, released or another holder. LEASE_STALE: wrong attempt generation. Refusals write nothing.
